                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • ਪਹਿਲੀ ਮਹਿਲਾ ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਮੁੱਕੇਬਾਜ਼ੀ ਚੈਂਪੀਅਨਸ਼ਿਪ 2001 ਵਿੱਚ ਸਕ੍ਰੈਂਟਨ, ਅਮਰੀਕਾ ਵਿੱਚ ਹੋਈ ਸੀ।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • IBA ਮਹਿਲਾ ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਮੁੱਕੇਬਾਜ਼ੀ ਚੈਂਪੀਅਨਸ਼ਿਪ ਇੰਟਰਨੈਸ਼ਨਲ ਬਾਕਸਿੰਗ ਐਸੋਸੀਏਸ਼ਨ (IBA) ਦੁਆਰਾ ਆਯੋਜਿਤ ਕੀਤੀ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ।

(हवाई किले)\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Example: She keeps talking about moving to Hollywood and becoming a movie star, but those are just castles in the air.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • "Unrealistic and impossible plan" means a plan or idea that is not practical or feasible in reality. (अवास्तविक और असंभव योजना)\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Therefore, the correct answer is: Unrealistic and impossible plan.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The idiom "Bone to pick" means to be angry or annoyed about something and want to discuss it. (किसी बात से नाराज होना और इसे चर्चा करना चाहना)\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Example: She called him because she had a bone to pick about the way he handled the project.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • "To be angry about something and want to discuss it" means feeling upset or agitated about a particular issue and having the desire to talk about it. (किसी बात से नाराज होना और इसे चर्चा करना चाहना)\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Example: John had a bone to pick with his colleague about the missed deadlines.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. To be angry about something and want to discuss it.
